Subject: Post-discovery: plan and schedule ML/Infra immersion (60-90m)

Hi Samira / Amit — thanks again for the intro call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to lock a technical immersion with our ML/Infra team so we can show an end-to-end runthrough and cover architecture, performance/cost tradeoffs, and integrations.

Recap (2 lines):
- You’re evaluating inference for a patient-facing summarization feature (short sequences, high concurrency, HIPAA concerns).
- Primary objectives for a deep-dive: latency targets at 150ms p95, token cost estimates, private deployment options and auditability.

Proposed next step: 60–90 minute technical immersion (we call this a TDX) with engineers from both teams. Suggested slots (US/PST and UTC shown):
- Wed Sep 29 — 10:00–11:15 PT / 17:00–18:15 UTC
- Thu Sep 30 — 09:00–10:15 PT / 16:00–17:15 UTC
- Mon Oct 4 — 13:00–14:15 PT / 20:00–21:15 UTC

Draft agenda (we can trim to 60 or extend to 90):
1) 5–10m: goals & attendee introductions
2) 35m: infra/runtime deep-dive (Ben to lead) — topology, KV cache, batching, quantization options
3) 20m: deployment options & security/compliance (priv infra, KMS/HSM, audit logs)
4) 15–25m: Q&A + next steps / action items

Please reply with: preferred slot, final attendee list (we need 2–3 engineers + a product lead from your side), and any pre-read or additional topics to add. I’ve attached a short prep checklist and a one-pager on our Dedicated vs Private options.

Attachments: TDX-Prep-Checklist.pdf (attachment stub)

Thanks — I’ll hold the top slot tentatively for 48 hours.

— Neha
